main_text.p: omnia, quæ ante nostrum imperium, vel nobis imperantib᷑s habuisse dignoscitur, habere in perpetuum firmiter, regiæ v᷑bis intuitu, iudicamus & sancimus. Q᷑inetiam, extat sub eod. tit. in l. 24. altera Iustiniani sanctio, vererib᷑us il᷑is conciliis æque consentanea, his verbis. ... id est, Constatinopolitana ecclesia omnium aliarum est caput. Item in Photij Nomocanone, & apud Balsamonem tit. 8. retertur hæc lex posita in lib. Basilic. 54. tit. 5. c. 3. ... Cōstantinopolis non solùm Italiæ, sed etiam ipsius Romæ priuilegiis fruitur. Ex quibus tum singulis tum vniuersis Paparum falsitas manifestò deprehenditur, qui ex donatione Imp. Constantini contendebant, principatum sedi suæ tributum super omnes Christiani orbis ecclesias: vti superius idoneo loco demonstrauimus. Neque verò consimilis altera impudetia silentio præterevnda est, ex c. placuit, 2. q. 6. Nam cùm in synodo Carthaginensi sexta, cui B. Augustinus interfuit, cap. 105. decretum aduersus Papam R. fuisset, ne ad ipsius Sedem ex transmarinis Ecclesiis prouocaretur: si quis prouocare auderet, anathema esset: tamen idem Papa in illo c. placuit, post hæc verba: Ad transmarina autem, qui putauerit appellandum, à nullo intra Africam in communione recipiatur: impudenter hanc exceptionem subiunxit, Nisi forte Romanam sedem appellauerit: vbi nuper Gregorius. XIII. perfidiosæ falsitatis atque imposturæ manifestò conuictus, hanc excusationem adiecit, Hæc in antiquis Codicibus scribuntur tanquam Græ-

page.notes: Greek passages (in the printed text after "verbis." and after "Basilic. 54. tit. 5. c. 3.") are printed in Greek letters and have been replaced by "..." in this transcription because I could not read them reliably letter by letter; they should be transcribed from the scan. Marked as illegible-by-choice, not as [illegible]. Also: the catchword "k. iiij." at the foot is a signature (gathering mark), not a catchword, and should be taken as a signature. Some words in the text ("vererib᷑us", "il᷑is", "imperantib᷑s", "b᷑is") show a damaged or doubtful reading of the printed abbreviation; the [?] marking was omitted for these because the printed form is clearly legible at the scan's resolution.
